title: 第15章 远遁千里第16章 黑市销赃
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
漆黑的矿洞深处，死寂无声。
前行约莫两里，空气变得潮湿，前方传来沉闷的流水轰鸣。
林渊在一处断崖前停下脚步。
断崖下方十余丈，一条宽约五丈的地下暗河奔腾汹涌，河水漆黑，散发着刺骨的寒意。
根据林家老祖的记忆，这条暗河横穿大半个楚国南部，流向相邻的临泉郡边界。
这是当年老祖突破筑基后期后，耗费十年时间秘密探明的一条退路。
为了防备万一，老祖至死都没有将这个秘密告诉过任何林家后辈。
如今，这条退路便宜了林渊。
林渊没有犹豫，一拍储物袋，金鳞盾脱手飞出。
在液化灵力的催动下，金鳞盾并未化作巨盾，而是化作一层实质般的金色流光，将他整个人包裹在内。
噗通。
林渊纵身一跃，跳入冰冷的暗河之中。
河水瞬间将他吞没。
暗河水流极快，且蕴含着地底深处的极寒之气，若是普通的炼气期修士，即便有法器护体，半个时辰内也会被冻结经脉。
但林渊如今已是筑基初期修为，肉身经过灵力液化时的洗礼，强韧程度远非炼气期可比。
他收敛全身气息，任由河水裹挟着身体，向着下游快速漂流。
——
一日一夜后。
暗河中段，一处地势开阔的地下溶洞内。
林渊破水而出，脚尖在湿滑的岩石上轻轻一点，稳稳地落在了一块干燥的石台上。

他散去金鳞盾的金光，浑身灵力微微一震，原本湿透的道袍瞬间升腾起一片白雾，转眼便恢复了干燥。
连续漂流了一天一夜，即便是筑基期修士，体内的灵力也消耗了三成。
林渊打量了一下四周。
这处溶洞极大，四周除了水流声，便只有偶尔滴落的水答声。
神识横扫一圈，方圆两百丈内没有任何生灵的气息。
他盘膝坐下，取出一块下品灵石握在掌心，开始运转功法恢复损耗的灵力。
半个时辰后，林渊睁开双眼，掌中的灵石已然化作一堆毫无灵气的灰色粉末。
体内的液化灵力重新恢复到了饱满状态。
“该清点收获了。”
林渊神色平静，将怀中搜集到的五个刘家修士的储物袋，以及先前在林家秘密宝库中得到的资源全部取了出来，摆放在面前。
刘铁等五人的储物袋里，共有下品灵石三百六十块。
加上林老祖储物袋的中品灵石三百八十七块、下品灵石两千多块，除掉给林大山的那一百块，他现在身上的下品灵石总数就达到了近两千五百块。
对于一个刚刚晋升的筑基初期散修来说，这无疑是一笔巨款。
许多底蕴不足的筑基初期散修，浑身家当加起来也未必能有五百块下品灵石。
除了灵石，林家宝库里还有贴满封灵符的玉盒，里面五个隔层，每层摆着一株两百年份以上的灵药，诸如紫精参、地心火莲等，这些都是炼制筑基期精进修为丹药的主药。
最神秘的就是《林氏家谱》，从老祖的记忆中，这里面涉及上古修仙遗迹，但目前还看不出什么端倪，只能等后面慢慢摸索了。
另外还有数件二阶炼器材料，其中一块乌金铁重达十斤，是淬炼飞剑的绝佳材料。
content_en:
Deep in the dark mine, there was deathly silence.
After walking for about two miles, the air became humid and the dull roar of running water came from ahead.
Lin Yuan stopped in front of a cliff.
More than ten feet below the cliff, an underground river about five feet wide was surging. The water was pitch black and exuded a biting chill.
According to the memory of the ancestor of the Lin family, this underground river crosses most of the southern part of the Chu Kingdom and flows to the border of the adjacent Linquan County.
This was a retreat that the ancestor spent ten years secretly exploring after breaking through to the late stage of foundation building.
In order to be on the safe side, the ancestor did not tell any of the younger generations of the Lin family this secret until his death.
Now, this retreat is cheaper for Lin Yuan.
Lin Yuan did not hesitate, slapped the storage bag, and the golden scale shield flew out.
Under the urging of the liquefied spiritual power, the golden scale shield did not turn into a giant shield, but turned into a layer of substantial golden flow, wrapping his entire body.
Plop.
Lin Yuan jumped into the cold underground river.
The river swallowed him instantly.
The underground river flows very fast and contains the extremely cold air deep underground. If it is an ordinary monk in the Qi refining stage, even if he has a magic weapon to protect his body, his meridians will be frozen within half an hour.
However, Lin Yuan is now in the early stage of foundation building. His physical body has been baptized by the liquefaction of spiritual power, and its strength is far from comparable to that in the Qi refining stage.
He gathered his breath and let the river water wrap around his body, drifting rapidly downstream.
——
After one day and one night.
In the middle section of the underground river, in an underground cave with open terrain.
Lin Yuan broke out of the water, tapped his toes on the slippery rocks, and landed steadily on a dry stone platform.
He dispersed the golden light of the golden scale shield, and his spiritual power shook slightly. A white mist instantly rose up from the soaked Taoist robe, and it was dry again in the blink of an eye.
After drifting continuously for a day and a night, even a monk in the foundation building stage had consumed 30% of his spiritual energy.
Lin Yuan looked around.
This cave is huge, and apart from the sound of water flowing around it, there is only the occasional sound of dripping water.
His spiritual consciousness swept across a circle, and there was no breath of any living thing within a radius of two hundred feet.
He sat down cross-legged, took out a low-grade spiritual stone, held it in his palm, and began to run the exercises to restore the lost spiritual power.
Half an hour later, Lin Yuan opened his eyes, and the spirit stone in his palm had turned into a pile of gray powder without any spiritual energy.
The liquefied spiritual power in the body returned to its full state.
“It’s time to count the harvest.”
Lin Yuan looked calm and took out all the storage bags of the five Liu family monks collected in his arms, as well as the resources previously obtained from the Lin family's secret treasure house, and placed them in front of him.
There were a total of 360 pieces of low-grade spiritual stones in the storage bags of Liu Tie and the other five people.
Including the 387 pieces of middle-grade spiritual stones and more than 2,000 pieces of low-grade spiritual stones in Patriarch Lin's storage bag, excluding the 100 pieces given to Lin Dashan, the total number of low-grade spiritual stones he now has on his body reaches nearly 2,500 pieces.
For a newly promoted casual cultivator in the early stages of foundation building, this is undoubtedly a huge sum of money.
Many casual cultivators in the early stages of foundation building who have insufficient foundation knowledge may not have 500 low-grade spiritual stones in total with all their belongings.
In addition to spiritual stones, the Lin family's treasury also contains jade boxes filled with spiritual talismans. There are five compartments inside, each containing an elixir that is more than two hundred years old, such as Purple Essence Ginseng, Earth Core Fire Lotus, etc. These are the main ingredients for refining the elixirs of the Foundation Establishment Stage.
The most mysterious one is the "Lin Family Tree". From the ancestor's memory, it involves the ancient ruins of cultivating immortals, but there are no clues yet, so we can only wait and explore later.
There are also several second-level weapon refining materials, including a piece of black gold iron weighing ten kilograms, which is an excellent material for tempering flying swords.
